nodes.summary: An eigenvector for a nonzero eigenvalue lies in the range: if `T v = μ • v` with `μ ≠ 0`, then `v = T (μ⁻¹ • v)`.
nodes.title: Eigenvectors for nonzero eigenvalues lie in the range

nodes.summary: Choose one eigenvector for each nonzero eigenvalue of `T`. The chosen eigenvectors are linearly independent (eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues) and all lie in the range of `T`.
nodes.title: Independent eigenvectors for distinct nonzero eigenvalues

nodes.summary: A finite-rank operator has only finitely many distinct nonzero eigenvalues.
nodes.title: Eigenvalue finiteness for finite-rank operators

nodes.summary: The spectrum of a finite-rank operator is finite.
nodes.title: Spectrum of a finite-rank operator is finite

nodes.summary: Every eigenvalue of a finite-rank operator lies in its spectrum.
nodes.title: Eigenvalues of a finite-rank operator lie in its spectrum

nodes.summary: A finite-rank operator is compact: it factors through its finite-dimensional range, and every continuous linear map out of a finite-dimensional (hence locally compact) space is compact.
nodes.title: Finite-rank operators are compact

nodes.summary: There are at most `finrank (range T)` distinct nonzero eigenvalues.
nodes.title: Eigenvalue-count bound for finite-rank operators

nodes.summary: The spectrum of a finite-rank operator has at most `finrank (range T) + 1` points.
nodes.title: Bound on the size of the spectrum of a finite-rank operator
Spectrum of a finite-rank operator on an infinite-dimensional space

nodes.summary: The spectrum of a finite-rank operator is contained in `{0} ∪ {eigenvalues}`: every nonzero spectral value is an eigenvalue, by the Fredholm alternative for compact operators.
nodes.title: Nonzero spectral values of a finite-rank operator are eigenvalues

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
